scene: The cramped wood-panelled cabin of an old steam trawler at dusk, charts and brass instruments on a table

subjects.description: A young woman with long red braided hair, pale freckled skin and a dark green hooded wool cloak, hood down
subjects.position: left of frame, seated at the chart table
subjects.action: pointing at a spot on a sea chart
subjects.pose: leaning forward, elbows on the table, face in three-quarter view

subjects.description: A heavy-set grey-bearded captain in a navy peacoat and knitted cap
subjects.pose: weight on one leg, head tilted down toward the chart

style: painterly cinematic concept art, visible brush texture, storyboard key frame
lighting: single warm oil lamp on the table as key light, cool dusk light through a small porthole
background: porthole with rain, coiled rope, a ticking brass chronometer, hanging oilskins
composition: two-shot, eye-level, table in the lower third forming a base line between them
